rule.objective: maximise validation recall = TP / |validation positives| (equivalently TP: same denominator for every configuration)
rule.constraint: Wilson 95% lower bound of validation benchmark precision TP/(TP+FP) >= the same bound for the cap-100 configuration of the same ranking version, minus 0.05
rule.reference: cap-100 baseline of the same version (v1 -> outputs/phase5, v2 -> outputs/phase5/ranking_v2)
rule.ineligible: configurations whose validation precision is undefined (no labelled predictions)
rule.candidates: caps 100, 250, 500, 1000 x versions v1, v2 (8 configurations)
rule.unlabelled_predictions: not counted as false; they do not enter precision
